messages.text: The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed best scores so a completed game only replaces a higher move count for the same board size. Sizes without a completed game now show “none,” including after reload.

All 140 unit tests and 77 browser tests passed, as did type checking and formatting for the changed files. The repository-wide formatting check still reports three unrelated files: `scripts/replay.test.ts`, `tests/accessibility.e2e.test.ts`, and `tests/layout.e2e.test.ts`.
